review.instructions: What should happen with this PR?

criteria.approve: clean change, tests included, no risks found
criteria.warn: can merge, but has minor issues (missing tests, unclear naming, small smells)
criteria.block: must not merge: secrets in code, broken build, obvious bugs
criteria.manual-review: sensitive or too large to judge automatically (auth, security, CI/CD, big refactors)

category.instructions: Which area of the project does this PR mainly affect?

criteria.code: application logic: features, bug fixes, business rules
criteria.ui: frontend components, styles, pages, user-facing text
criteria.security: authentication, permissions, secrets handling, vulnerability fixes
criteria.performance: caching, query optimisation, reducing load or memory use
criteria.dependencies: package.json, requirements.txt, lock files, library upgrades
criteria.configuration: config files, environment variables, feature flags
criteria.architecture: project structure, new modules, interfaces between components

urgency.instructions: How urgently should this PR be merged?

criteria.low: nice to have, can wait (docs, cleanup)
criteria.medium: normal feature or fix, merge in the regular cycle
criteria.high: fixes a bug users are hitting or unblocks other work
criteria.urgent: fixes a production outage or a security issue

type.instructions: What kind of change is this PR?
